story: In the diverse world of birds, the Black Backed Dwarf Kingfisher (Ceyx erithaca) stands out. This species, part of the Alcedinidae family, is a resident of Lowland forests near streams/ponds; gardens; parks; wooded areas; and mangroves. Its IUCN Red List status is Near Threatened (NT), which serves as a call to action for habitat preservation. The Black Backed Dwarf Kingfisher is more than just a bird; it is a symbol of the rich biodiversity that we must protect. Through this poster, we hope to foster a greater understanding and appreciation for the Black Backed Dwarf Kingfisher and its role in the ecosystem.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
